en.bdb: Relationship of the discipleshipof the Guru is the true relation

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦਾ ਪੜਦਾਦਿਓਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪੋਤਾ ਪੜਪੋਤਾ ਨਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: piau dhaadhaa paRadhaadhio(n) putr potaa paRapotaa nataa|

en.bdb: From father, grand father, great grand father are born son, grand son,great grand son respectively and from great grand son is born simply a relative (natte, having no specific relational name).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂ ਦਾਦੀ ਪੜਦਾਦੀਓਂ ਫੁਫੀ ਭੈਣ ਧੀਆਂ ਸਣਖਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: maa(n) dhaadhee paRadhaadheeo(n) fufee bhain dheeaa(n) sanakhataa|

en.bdb: The relationship of mother, grand mother, greatgrand mother, father's sister, sister, daughter, and daughter-in-law is also respected.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਨਾਨੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਨਾਨਾ ਪੜਨਾਨੀ ਪਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: naanaa naanee aakheeaai paRanaanaa paRanaanee pataa|

en.bdb: Maternal grand father and mother and maternal great grand father and mother are also known.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਇਆ ਚਾਚਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਾਈ ਚਾਚੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: taiaa chaachaa jaaneeaai taiee chaachee maiaa mataa|

en.bdb: Father's elder brother (Taiya) younger brother (chachc7a, their wives (tayi, chachi)et al. also remain absorbed in wordly affairs (maya).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਣੀਆਂ ਮਾਸੀ ਮਾਸੜ ਦੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: maame tai maamaneeaa(n) maasee maasaR dhe ra(n)g rataa|

en.bdb: Mama, mann- (mother's brother and his wife), mast; masa"; (mother's sister and her husband), all look dyed in their own colours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੜ ਫੁਫੜ ਸਾਕ ਸਭ ਸਹੁਰਾ ਸਸ ਸਾਲੀ ਸਾਲਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: maasaR fufaR saak sabh sahuraa sas saalee saalataa|

en.bdb: Masar, phuphet (mother's sister's husband and father's sister's husband respectively), father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law (sali) and brother-in-law (sala) are also close.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਏਰ ਪਿਤੀਏਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਉਲੇਰ ਫੁਫੇਰ ਅਵਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: taaer pite'eer mel mil mauler fufer avataa|

en.bdb: The relationship of chacha's-in-law and those of the mama-in-law and phaphd-in-law are known as inconvenient relations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਢੂ ਕੁੜਮ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭ ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਨਿਸਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: saa(n)ddoo kuRam kuTa(n)b sabh nadhee naav sa(n)jog nisataa|

en.bdb: The relation­ship of sister-in-law's husband (Sandhi) and father-in-law of your daughter or son (Kuram) are momentary and fake like those passengers of a boat sitting in a group.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨਾ ਵਿਛੜੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਭਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachaa saak naa vichhaRai saadhasa(n)gat gur bhaiee bhataa|

en.bdb: The true relationship is with those brothers who meet in the holy congregation.They never get separated.
Through the holy congrega­tion, the gurmukhs learn the technique of renunciation amidst enjoyments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਉ ਦੇ ਨਾਂਹ ਪਿਆਰ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਫੁਫੀ ਨ ਪਿਤੀਏ ਤਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: peeau dhe naa(n)h piaar tul na fufee na pite'ee taae|

en.bdb: The love of father's sister or cousins are not equal to the father's love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਊ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਮਾਮੇ ਮਾਸੀ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: maauoo het na pujanee het na maame maasee jaae|

en.bdb: Love of mother cannot be equalled by the love of the children of maternal uncle and mother's sister.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਾਂ ਸਧਰ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਆਣ ਅੰਬਾਕੜੀਆਂ ਜੇ ਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)baa(n) sadhar naa lahai aan a(n)baakaReeaa(n) je khaae|

en.bdb: By eating mango blossms the desire for eating mangoes is not fulfilled.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੀ ਪਾਨ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਡਕਾਰ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: moolee paan paTa(n)taraa vaas ddakaar paragaTee aae|

en.bdb: The smells of radish leaves and betel are differ­ent and are identified through smell and eructation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਦੀਵੇ ਲਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj cha(n)dh na pujanee dheeve lakh taare chamakaae|

en.bdb: Lacs of lighted lamps and stars cannot compete with the sun and the moon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਮਜੀਠ ਕੁਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਥੋਈ ਵੇਸ ਵਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g majeeTh kusu(n)bh dhaa sadhaa sathoiee ves vaTaae|

en.bdb: The colour of madder is steadfast and the colour of safflower changes very soon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur tul na miharavaan maat pitaa na dhev sabaae|

en.bdb: Neither mother and father nor all the gods can be as gracious as the true Guru.
All these relations have been thoroughly tested.
